Binance Wallet, together with BNB Chain, is jointly hosting the Agent ID Hackathon. Developers may participate and explore innovative use cases for Agent ID in on-chain applications. Agent ID is the on-chain name of an Agentic Wallet, taking the form of name.ai. Each user can claim only one Agent ID, and it is non-transferable. Participating projects must be deployed on BNB Chain and actively use Agent ID. Both new and existing projects are eligible to submit.

I. Project Awards: 58,000 USDC
Open to all eligible developers and project teams, the following two awards are available:
1. Agent ID Ecosystem Pioneer Award

Rewards will be given to projects that based on the organizers’ metrics genuinely drive the growth of the Agent ID ecosystem, based on a comprehensive ranking that considers factors, such as the number of interacting Agent ID addresses, transaction volume, or number of transactions.

Rankings will be determined based on real on-chain data. During the Submission Period, Binance Wallet team will calculate weighted scores using metrics, such as the number of Agent ID holder addresses interacting with participating contracts, as well as the resulting transaction volume or transaction count. The top 10 projects will receive rewards.

Note: Only contract addresses submitted by participants (including token contracts) will be counted, and interacting addresses must be addresses that hold an Agent ID.
2. Agent Application Innovation Award

Rewards will be granted to outstanding projects that integrate Agent ID into real-world application scenarios and demonstrate innovation, as well as practical implementation value in the organizers’ opinion.

Rankings will be determined based on judging panel scores. The panel will evaluate participating projects across multiple dimensions, including feasibility, practicality, innovation, and level of completion. The top 10 projects will receive rewards.
Each project may only receive one award.
Winning projects deemed exceptionally outstanding by the judging panel will be featured on the Binance Wallet Agentic Wallet ecosystem page and included in future Agent ID ecosystem campaigns.
Agent Application Innovation Award Judging Rules
Judging Panel

The Innovation Award will be evaluated by a judging panel composed of representatives from Binance Wallet, BNB Chain, and related technical and ecosystem fields, who will assess projects that meet the eligibility requirements.
Scoring Criteria
The judging panel will use a 100-point system, evaluating projects across the following four dimensions:
Dimension
Weight
Agent ID Application Depth
Whether Agent ID is genuinely integrated into the product's core functionality and business flow, and whether it demonstrates real application value
Practicality & Feasibility
Whether the project addresses a real need, and whether the use case is reasonable and feasible
Product Completion
Whether the product is live, with complete core features available for users to experience
Innovation
Whether the project explores new Agent ID use cases with differentiation and innovative value
Evaluation Process
Eligibility Review: Confirm that the project meets the participation requirements and the Innovation Award's minimum eligibility threshold.
Project Evaluation: The judging panel evaluates and scores qualifying projects based on the unified scoring criteria.
Result Confirmation: The judging panel determines the final award rankings based on total scores.
Result Announcement: Binance Wallet team officially announces the winning projects and final results of the Innovation Award.
If multiple projects receive the same final score, the judging panel will give priority to the project’s depth of Agent ID integration and product completion in making the final determination.

Binance Wallet reserves the right to verify participant eligibility, project materials, and evaluation results. For clarity, the scoring criteria above is set out for informational purposes only. The judging panel reserves the right to solely determine final scores.

Participating projects must comply with the following safety red lines. Violation of any of the following will result in immediate disqualification:

No web-based QR code login for Agentic Wallet. Projects must not allow users to scan QR codes or enter pairing codes on third-party websites to sign in, nor store users' login sessions on servers to place orders on users' behalf.

For any operation involving user assets (transfers, trades, or approvals), the project’s skills must not contain prompts that attempt to bypass user transaction confirmation. Users must be able to see and confirm such actions themselves.

No unauthorized asset transfers. This includes scheduled collection, automatic transfers to fixed addresses, bundled extra transfers in transactions, or soliciting unlimited approvals without the user's knowledge.

Contracts must be open-source with disclosed owner permissions. Permissions such as minting, changing tax rates, pausing trading, freezing assets, or withdrawing user funds must be clearly documented.
No impersonation of the Binance brand. Project names, token names, and domain names must not use "Binance" / "BNB" to impersonate the official brand.
No collection of sensitive credentials. Projects must not collect users' seed phrases, private keys, API secrets, or pairing codes.
Participating projects must not promise returns externally. Terms such as "passive income" or "automatic money-making" are prohibited.
Products involving trading must display risk warnings on the page.
Agent ID must not be packaged as a tool for "looking up other people's wallets by name."

Binance Wallet reserves the right to disqualify projects exhibiting abnormal behavior, including but not limited to malicious volume manipulation, illegitimate mass account registration for interactions, or other activities showing signs of market manipulation.

About Binance Wallet

Binance Wallet is a self-custody crypto wallet, designed to empower users in the realm of decentralized finance (DeFi). Serving as a digital gateway to blockchain-based applications (dApps), it offers users a secure and streamlined mBNBod to manage their cryptocurrencies, execute token swaps across multiple chains, earn yields, and interact with a variety of blockchain platforms. For more information, please refer to this page.
About Agent OS

Binance Agent OS is a developer platform under the Binance Intelligence architecture that connects compatible AI applications and Agents to Binance-supported features through user-controllable permissions.

Binance Agent OS integrates Binance APIs, Binance Wallet Agentic Hub, Binance x402, Binance Skill Hub, and support for the Model Context Protocol (MCP) into a more cohesive ecosystem serving developers, users, and the broader industry. This release reflects Binance's commitment to building infrastructure for agentic crypto experiences and lays the foundation for continued expansion of agentic skills, wallet capabilities, and developer tools.

Participating projects must comply with the following safety red lines. Violation of any of the following will result in immediate disqualification:

No web-based QR code login for Agentic Wallet. Projects must not allow users to scan QR codes or enter pairing codes on third-party websites to sign in, nor store users' login sessions on servers to place orders on users' behalf.

For any operation involving user assets (transfers, trades, or approvals), the project’s skills must not contain prompts that attempt to bypass user transaction confirmation. Users must be able to see and confirm such actions themselves.

No unauthorized asset transfers. This includes scheduled collection, automatic transfers to fixed addresses, bundled extra transfers in transactions, or soliciting unlimited approvals without the user's knowledge.

Contracts must be open-source with disclosed owner permissions. Permissions such as minting, changing tax rates, pausing trading, freezing assets, or withdrawing user funds must be clearly documented.
No impersonation of the Binance brand. Project names, token names, and domain names must not use "Binance" / "BNB" to impersonate the official brand.
No collection of sensitive credentials. Projects must not collect users' seed phrases, private keys, API secrets, or pairing codes.
Participating projects must not promise returns externally. Terms such as "passive income" or "automatic money-making" are prohibited.
Products involving trading must display risk warnings on the page.
Agent ID must not be packaged as a tool for "looking up other people's wallets by name."
